notes: Story Questlines keeps an unreadable save aside instead of wiping it, finishes terrain that could not be put back once you are near, and no longer offers Old Words after the gift ending.
Only the player who locked a Silly Enchants librarian, or an operator, can change it, and Town Projects residents and named villagers are skipped.
Reset talents costs what your realm set, and ores, melons and pumpkins moved by a piston no longer count as fresh Guilds finds.
Titles an operator takes away stay gone, Sell fish counts only the plain fish you carry, and a sand or snow roof is no longer dry ground for Rain Extras.
The Minimap clears Arrived when it is off and calls its setting Mob range, and the Realm Configuration menu leaves optional players out by default.

saga_bp.notes: A save that cannot be read is copied to saga:p_bak, damaged places are never overwritten, unfinished terrain restores wait for a player to come near, boss warnings and re-asks are spaced out, and Old Words is not offered after the gift ending.

admin_bp.notes: Optional player lists start on (leave out), a form reads the players it showed, and Show a Title works with seconds but no subtitle.

skills_bp.notes: The Reset talents price in the menu and the confirmation follows /realm:config.

guilds_bp.notes: Ores, melons and pumpkins pushed by a piston count as placed, not as fresh finds.

silly_bp.notes: Only the player who locked a librarian, or an operator, can re-lock it, Town Projects residents and named villagers are skipped, and the test hook works from the server console only.

map_bp.notes: Arrived clears when the Minimap is disabled, the scan cache cap comes back down after a scan, and the mob setting is named Mob range.

titles_bp.notes: A built-in title or trail an operator takes away is not unlocked again.

stash_bp.notes: The help text says only the hotbar, armor and offhand are the same on every page.

fishing_bp.notes: Sell fish trims the basket to the plain fish you carry, keeping the cheapest.

rain_bp.notes: A roof of sand, terracotta, snow or ice is not dry ground, and only natural ground ids count.

meteor_bp.notes: An impact waits only for its own spot to load, and up to 5 retries cover unloaded alternate spots.
